How it works

Three steps. No garden tools.

The flow is designed to feel familiar from deposit to redemption.

Mint USD Bloom

Deposit an accepted stable asset and receive USD Bloom at the current exchange rate.

Accrue automatically

Value from protocol strategies is reflected without a separate claim or harvest action.

Redeem when ready

Return USD Bloom to the protocol and receive available reserve assets.

FAQ

A clearer view.

USD Bloom is a fictional concept. These answers explain the intended product model, not a live offering.

The concept uses reserve-backed minting and redemption, with liquidity spread across approved venues to keep pricing close to one dollar.

The proposed model allocates reserves across transparent lending and market-neutral strategies. Returns would vary with market conditions.

Any on-chain financial product can carry smart-contract, liquidity, counterparty, and market risks. A live product would need audits and clear risk disclosures.

A production version would begin with wallet connection, eligibility checks, and a clear review of terms before any mint transaction.
